{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.92

|gr1= GUI Control - Positioning

|descr= Sets the width of a 2D control. [[ctrlCommit]] is required to complete the operation.

|s1= control [[ctrlSetPositionW]] w

|p1=control: [[Control]] - 2D control

|p2=w: [[Number]] - width of the control

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
_ctrl ctrlSetPositionW 0.5;
_ctrl ctrlCommit 1;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[ctrlSetPosition]] [[ctrlSetPositionX]] [[ctrlSetPositionY]] [[ctrlSetPositionH]]
}}
